 Rapiers are a type of one-handed martial melee weapon. The following are some base attributes common to most rapiers, although special or magical variants may be significantly different. For the most common, nonmagical type of this weapon, see Rapier. Further down below, you can find a list of all rapiers in the game.

Properties

Damage
1d8 (1~8) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠Piercing
Details
 One-Handed
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Finesse
 Dippable

Actions

If you have proficiency, equip in main hand to gain:

 Piercing Strike ()
Stab an enemy and possibly inflict  Gaping Wounds. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Weakening Strike ()
Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict  Weak Grip. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Flourish ()
Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent  Off Balance. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
